contents.text: Which error does a blocked seal-water strainer cause on P-201, and what pressure clears it?
A blocked seal-water strainer causes Error E-217: seal-water pressure low. The seal-water pressure that clears Error E-217 is at least 2.0 bar.

WI-FS-031: Cleaning the seal-water strainer upstream of V-114
# WI-FS-031: Cleaning the seal-water strainer upstream of V-114
The seal-water line to pump P-201 has a Y-strainer with a 100-micron screen upstream of valve V-114.
A blocked screen is the most common cause of error E-217 at the Riverside plant.
1. Stop P-201 and close the isolation valve upstream of the strainer.
5. Check that the gauge shows a seal-water pressure of 2.0 to 3.0 bar.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-217: seal-water pressure low
## Error E-217: seal-water pressure low
Error E-217 means seal-water pressure low.
The controller trips the pump when seal-water pressure stays below 1.5 bar for 10 seconds, to protect the mechanical seal.
Check that seal-water valve V-114 is open and that its strainer is clean, then reset the alarm at the local panel.
2. A blocked strainer upstream of V-114 (work instruction WI-FS-031 describes the cleaning).
To clear E-217, restore the seal-water pressure to at least 2.0 bar, wait until the alarm light stops flashing, then press RESET on the local panel.
If the alarm returns within an hour, don't restart the pump again; raise a work order for the seal-water system.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-201: suction pressure low
## Error E-201: suction pressure low
Error E-201 means the suction pressure fell below 0.3 bar.
2. The suction strainer is blocked.
Open the suction valve fully, clean the suction strainer and check the tank level before resetting E-201.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-302: seal-water pressure switch fault
## Error E-302: seal-water pressure switch fault
Error E-302 means pressure switch PS-31 reports pressure while the seal-water supply is closed.
The controller checks PS-31 each time the seal-water valve closes.
Until it is replaced, check the seal-water pressure at the local gauge every shift.
